steps.prompt: Create a single playful title logo that reads exactly Sound Basket. Large rounded glossy toy bubble letters, slightly bouncy baseline, thick warm-cream inner outline and deep navy outer outline. Use coral red, orange, golden yellow, sky cyan, violet, and candy pink only; no green or lime. Add two tiny golden-yellow toy stars as end ornaments. Wide horizontal one-line lockup, centered, generous padding. Perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. Exact spelling and capitalization; no subtitle, button, characters, basket illustration, or watermark.
